facts.text: Yogaville, a spiritual community in Buckingham County, Virginia, was founded by Swami Satchidananda in 1979 on 600 acres he spotted while flying over the South.
The Light Of Truth Universal Shrine, shaped like a lotus and crowned with a gold‑leaf dome, opened in 1986 as a symbol of interfaith unity.
Integral Yoga, the philosophy behind Yogaville, blends Hatha, Raja, Karma, Bhakti, and Jnana paths to foster balanced physical, mental, and spiritual growth.
After Swami Satchidananda’s death in 2002, the Integral Yoga International organization took over governance, with a board of trustees and senior teachers guiding the community.
Yogaville’s daily routine includes meditation, yoga, communal meals, and selfless service, reflecting its commitment to Karma Yoga.
The community emphasizes environmental sustainability, using solar power, organic farming, and waste reduction to support its eco‑friendly lifestyle.
